Within each two-file pair increasing/decreasing current maps respectively. One physical cooldown. No target response read before separate retained forecast hash. Full roster, no early/late exclusions or slicing by outcome. Other incomplete or setup-different maps are not added.
observable: Each map is reindexed by ascending signed commanded I,B. Compare raw Keithley V(B,I) minus same measured sweep and B row V(B,0). Primary errors use recorded e-2V channel units; zero-bias value used in target contrast only; predictions have no access to either held map. Cancels rowwise additive offsets. No independent absolute B-zero, internal trapped flux, contact voltage, actual microscopic state or dwell-to-equilibrium proof. These DC four-quadrant runs have lock-in disabled, no matching driven Shapiro simulation; published RF figures are not an equal-input DC multihistory map baseline.
mechanism: Assume current-phase odd under simultaneous phase/field reversal, odd dissipative law, reflected ramp/initial conditions. Candidate reflects commanded B, sign of I, current traversal branch, and sign of voltage change from zero. Neither equilibrium reciprocity alone nor approximate symmetry in a raw plot implies the driven transfer.
controls: Same field/current persistence, bias-reflection only, field-reflection only, joint reflection, uniform four-arm average, and empirical four-arm no-intercept ridge mix trained against both early opposite-field maps with ridge 1e-8*trace(XTX)/4. Same inputs eligible for all controls. No late fit, offset search, internal field alignment or target-selected trim.
gate: On both entire late target maps the joint-reflection candidate must beat every other arm strictly on full-map RMSE and on the maximum across fields of within-row RMSE (four components, all must pass). Report both maps, every comparator, worst joint-reflection point including all forecasts/raw/reference/current/field; no treating 106722 samples as independent.
